title.original: DIAP: A Decentralized Agent Identity Protocol with Zero-Knowledge Proofs and a Hybrid P2P Stack
title.zh: DIAP：具有零知识证明和混合P2P堆栈的去中心化代理身份协议
title.en: DIAP: A Decentralized Agent Identity Protocol with Zero-Knowledge Proofs and a Hybrid P2P Stack

inclusion_reason.zh: DIAP 将内容寻址身份、零知识所有权证明、发现和 QUIC 传输整合为可运行的去中心化 Agent 通信协议栈。
inclusion_reason.en: DIAP integrates content-addressed identity, zero-knowledge ownership proofs, discovery, and QUIC transport into a runnable decentralized agent communication stack.

abstract.zh: DIAP 将 Agent 身份绑定到 IPFS/IPNS 内容标识，以零知识证明动态证明所有权，并用混合 P2P 栈完成发现和高性能通信。
abstract.en: DIAP binds agent identity to IPFS/IPNS content identifiers, proves ownership dynamically with zero knowledge, and combines P2P discovery with high-performance communication.

problem.zh: 中心化身份中介形成信任瓶颈，缺少去中心化解析又会破坏 Agent 跨网络迁移后的持久身份和隐私保护。
problem.en: Central identity intermediaries create trust bottlenecks, while absent decentralized resolution breaks persistent identity and privacy across network migration.

approach.zh: 协议以不可变内容 ID 锚定身份，用 Noir ZKP 无状态证明所有权，并组合 DID-Key、GossipSub 发现与 QUIC 数据交换。
approach.en: The protocol anchors identity in immutable content IDs, uses Noir zero-knowledge proofs for stateless ownership, and combines DID-Key, GossipSub discovery, and QUIC exchange.

system_design.zh: Rust SDK 内置预编译证明电路和通用证明管理器，身份资料驻留 IPFS/IPNS，Libp2p 负责发现，Iroh 负责点对点传输。
system_design.en: A Rust SDK embeds a precompiled proof circuit and universal proof manager; profiles live on IPFS/IPNS, Libp2p handles discovery, and Iroh carries peer traffic.

key_results.zh: 实现展示了无需外部 ZKP 工具链即可即时生成可验证、隐私保护的身份所有权证明，并形成完整去中心化通信栈。
key_results.en: The implementation demonstrates immediate privacy-preserving identity proofs without an external ZKP toolchain and integrates them into a decentralized communication stack.

limitations.zh: 摘要未给出大规模或对抗部署评测；内容可用性、密钥恢复、身份撤销、垃圾发现和 P2P 元数据泄露仍是关键风险。
limitations.en: No large-scale adversarial deployment is reported; content availability, key recovery, revocation, discovery spam, and P2P metadata leakage remain key risks.

notes.zh: 实验矩阵与数值将在全文人工复核后补充；当前留空以避免从摘要推断。
notes.en: The experiment matrix and numbers await full-text manual review; fields remain empty to avoid inferring them from an abstract.
